newsitem.title: GERMANY: Minor weld fault at German nuclear power station.
newsitem.headline: Minor weld fault at German nuclear power station.

text.p: A faulty weld was discovered at a German nuclear power station on Thursday but no radiation has escaped and members of the public were not exposed to any danger, a spokesman for the plant said.

The faulty weld was found in a pipe which forms part of a cleaning system for water from the reactor at the Biblis plant in the central state of Hesse, the spokesman said. The station is run by power company RWE Energie.
The spokesman said the fault was so tiny that no water was escaping from the pipe, which was located far from the reactor.
Engineers were considering how to repair the weld and should be able to carry out the necessary measures without affecting the running of the plant, he said.
The spokesman said the fault was "meaningless from a security point of view" and posed no danger to the public.
